## What should Fluid Reader do?

Describe the change.

If this is a new command or search alias, use the command request template instead.

## Why is it useful?

Tell us who it helps and when.

Good examples:

- Helps people file better bugs without sharing private text.
- Helps keyboard users do a common task with fewer steps.
- Helps local-only users avoid turning on LLM.

## Roadmap fit

If this matches [docs/ROADMAP.md](../../docs/ROADMAP.md), say which section.

## Current workaround

Tell us what you do today, if anything.

## Extra notes

Add links, examples, or screenshots if they are safe to share.
